correctness.rationale: For each facet a from factor i, direct orthogonal product geometry gives m_(ia)(P)=m_a(P_i)V/V_i. Same-factor ridge conductance scales by V/V_i; distinct-factor ridge conductance is m_a(P_i)m_b(P_j)V/(V_i V_j) because normals are perpendicular. Divergence theorem gives Σ_a m_a(P_i)=d_iV_i, hence (L_P f)_(ia)=(L_i f_i)_a+Σ_(j≠i)d_j(f_(ia)−bar(f_j)). The mass-orthogonal even facet space decomposes into centered even factor modes with eigenvalues shifted n-d_i and a k-dimensional block-constant space with eigenvalues zero and n of multiplicity k-1. This covers all eigenvalues and multiplicities even for segment factors. Cross-polytope facets give a Boolean cube network with c/m=(d-1)/2, eigenvalues r(d-1), even Walsh r; the segment×C_d prism has single first eigenvalue d+1 for d≥3 and dimension-four example {0,4,5,5,5}. An independent symbolic product-network derivation and comparison with fully inspected cross-polytope/parallelotope original proofs corroborate. The finite supplied verify.py checks only selected products, not all dimensions.
